csv_project_name: Design Service for NYSTA Fueling Facilities
csv_scope_of_work: The New York State Thruway Authority (the Authority or NYSTA ) is seeking Proposals ( Proposals ) from qualified, experienced, and financially secure firms to redevelop, operate and maintain (i.e., design, construct, and finance) 29 Fueling Facilities (as further described herein) at the 27 Food/Fuel Faculties located along, and immediately accessible from, the New York State Thruway, see Exhibit 1 - NYSTA Fueling Facilities Map. Fueling Facilities is defined as the fueling areas, forecourts, canopies, kiosks, retail buildings, fuel dispensing infrastructure, pavement, striping, signage, utilities and anything else within the Fueling Facility Area of Responsibility (see Exhibit 5 - Fueling Facilities Area Responsibility Maps), unless otherwise specifically noted within this RFP (hereinafter Fueling Facilities
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 24C20- Pre-Submittal Notes: Registration deadline: April 30, 2026- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 05/04/2026 10:00 AM EDT- Pre-Submittal Location: 80 Wolf Rd, COLONIE, NY, 122052608, USA- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Recommended- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 05/29/2026 05:00 PM EDT - Questions contact: Caitlin Cady at Caitlin.Cady@thruway.ny.gov or Andrew Trombley at Andrew.Trombley@thruway.ny.gov -Pre-Bid meeting May 4 at 10:00 AM EDT- Contract participation goal: MWBE -30% SDVOB -6%
title: Design Services for NYSTA Fueling Facilities
short_description: Redevelopment, design, construction, financing, operation, and maintenance of 29 highway fueling facilities.
project_location: Albany, New York, USA; 27 food/fuel facilities along the New York State Thruway.
project_scope: The project covers redevelopment of 29 fueling facilities at 27 food/fuel service areas immediately accessible from the New York State Thruway. Scope includes fueling areas, forecourts, canopies, kiosks, retail buildings, fuel dispensing infrastructure, pavement, striping, signage, utilities, and all related elements within the defined facility responsibility areas. The assignment includes design, construction, financing, operation, and maintenance.
services: Architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering; integrated design-build-finance-operate-maintain services.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering and canopy/building components, which may involve some relevant structural design work.
- Large multi-site infrastructure program with 29 fueling facilities offers substantial overall volume.
- However, the project is primarily a fueling/service-area redevelopment and operations concession, not a clearly architecturally demanding bridge or long-span special structure.
- Strong emphasis on redevelopment, operation, maintenance, and financing reduces direct fit with sbp's core profile.
- Building and civil works appear conventional; no notable spans, lightweight structures, or innovative structural features are described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The documents describe a large program covering 29 fueling facilities at 27 service areas, including canopies, kiosks, retail buildings, fuel infrastructure, pavement, signage, and utilities, but provide no budget figure from which a reliable USD estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No planning fee or engineering fee is stated in the source. Because the procurement combines design, construction, financing, operation, and maintenance in one concession-style package, a realistic sbp fee cannot be isolated from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified, experienced, and financially secure firms are requested. No specific minimum number or type of reference projects is stated in the source excerpt.
contracting_authority: New York State Thruway Authority (NYSTA), Albany, NY, USA. Contact: Sarah Normile, Phone: 518-436-2740, Fax: 518-471-5808, Email: sarah.normile@thruway.ny.gov, Website: https://pbss.thruway.ny.gov/index.aspx. Questions contact: Caitlin Cady (Caitlin.Cady@thruway.ny.gov) or Andrew Trombley (Andrew.Trombley@thruway.ny.gov).
notes: Project No. 24C20. Current date in sheet: 2026-05-24; original date: 2026-04-28. Registration deadline: 2026-04-30. Pre-submittal meeting: 2026-05-04 10:00 AM EDT at 80 Wolf Rd, Colonie, NY 12205-2608, USA; attendance recommended. Questions deadline: 2026-05-29 05:00 PM EDT. Contract participation goals: MWBE 30%, SDVOB 6%. Although structural engineering is listed, the procurement is primarily a multi-site fuel/service facility redevelopment and concession package.
